instructions: Cook rice. Stir-fry garlic and vegetables, add rice and soy sauce, and toss until hot.
Saute onion, garlic and ginger. Add spices and tomato, then simmer with chickpeas.
Prepare a tomato-onion gravy, add spices and paneer, then finish with butter and cream.
Cook pasta. Saute garlic in olive oil, add lemon juice and zest, then toss with pasta.
Cook quinoa and combine with chopped vegetables and chickpeas. Dress with lemon.
Saute vegetables, add curry paste and coconut milk, and simmer until tender.
Cook pasta and prepare a quick tomato-garlic sauce. Toss with basil and olive oil.
Saute vegetables and chili, add oats and water, and cook until creamy.
Saute aromatics, add lentils and vegetables with water or stock, and simmer until tender.
Stir-fry vegetables over high heat, add garlic and soy sauce, and cook until crisp-tender.
Cook kidney beans until tender, prepare a spiced tomato gravy, and serve with rice.
Rinse poha. Temper mustard seeds, saute onion and vegetables, then mix in poha and peanuts.
Warm beans and tortillas. Fill with tomato, onion and avocado, then finish with lime.
Mash avocado lightly and combine with chickpeas and chopped vegetables. Add lime and coriander.
Saute mushrooms and garlic, add cooked rice and soy sauce, and finish with spring onion.
Roast semolina. Temper spices and saute vegetables, add water, then gradually stir in semolina.
Crumble tofu and saute with vegetables, turmeric and seasoning until lightly browned.
Cook lentils and vegetables, add tamarind and sambar powder, and simmer before tempering.
Saute spices and aromatics, add potato and cauliflower, cover and cook until tender.
Cook noodles. Stir-fry vegetables and toss with noodles and soy sauce.
Combine chickpeas and chopped vegetables with olives and a lemon dressing.
Cook lentils. Add sauteed spinach, tomato and spices, then simmer briefly.
Spread hummus on tortilla, add vegetables and lettuce, roll tightly and slice.
Roast sweet potato, cook quinoa, and assemble with chickpeas, greens and tahini.
Saute aromatics and vegetables, add rice and coconut milk, and cook until fluffy.
Cook chicken, add teriyaki-style sauce, and serve over rice with steamed vegetables.
Marinate chicken with yogurt, spices and lemon, then grill or bake until cooked through.
Scramble eggs, stir-fry vegetables, add rice and soy sauce, then toss together.
Season fish with lemon, pepper and garlic, then pan-cook or bake until flaky.
Simmer chicken and vegetables in stock until tender. Shred chicken before serving.
Boil eggs. Prepare a spiced onion-tomato gravy and simmer eggs in the sauce.
Marinate paneer and vegetables in spiced yogurt, then grill or bake until lightly charred.
Top pizza dough with sauce, vegetables and mozzarella. Bake until the crust is crisp.
Spread tomato on dough, add mozzarella and basil, drizzle with olive oil and bake.
Cook pasta. Saute mushrooms and garlic, add cream and parmesan, then combine with pasta.
Toast bread, top with mashed avocado and a cooked egg, then season with lemon and pepper.
Cook seasoned chicken and assemble over rice with beans, corn, tomato and avocado.
Slice beef thinly and stir-fry quickly with vegetables, garlic and soy sauce.
Drain tuna and combine with vegetables, corn and lettuce. Dress with lemon.
Cook pasta and chicken separately. Saute vegetables and combine everything with olive oil.
Prepare dosa batter, spread thinly on a hot pan, and fill with lightly sauteed vegetables.
Steam fermented idli batter. Prepare sambar with lentils, vegetables and spices.
Saute whole spices, onion and vegetables, add rice and water, and cook until fluffy.
Blanch and blend spinach. Prepare a spiced gravy, add paneer and finish with cream.
Cook onion and cashew into a smooth base, add vegetables and coconut milk, and simmer.
Saute vegetables, add tomato and stock, then simmer with beans and pasta.
Cook seasoned lentils and fill tortillas with lentils, tomato, onion and avocado.
Prepare rice and arrange with vegetables, avocado and edamame. Serve with soy sauce.
Cook noodles. Mix peanut butter and soy sauce into a sauce and toss with vegetables.
Combine chickpeas, mango and vegetables. Add lime and coriander just before serving.
